description: This source file defines the Order model class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Sale namespace. It provides methods to retrieve a single order and multiple orders from the database, including detailed processing of order data, related address information, customer details, and order status. The class interacts with the database layer to build and execute queries based on provided filters, sorts, and pagination.
